verdict.rationale: Slack's Huddles feature lets any user click the headphones icon in a channel/DM header to instantly start audio or video calls with screen sharing, all inside the app, and includes admin-manageable extras like AI notes and saved shared content. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of admin-specific controls/permissions for enabling or restricting huddles, and no independent hands-on corroboration beyond Slack's own marketing docs.
